prompt.project_info: Create a high-angle coastal iPhone front-camera selfie on a bright sandy beach.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with platinum-blonde tight double braids, ice-blue eyes, pale natural skin texture, expressionless wide-eyed gaze, blue nail polish, and a light-blue opaque fitted top with a secure neckline.
prompt.composition_elements: First-person high-angle selfie, one hand blocking strong sunlight, sandy beach and blurred horizon, deep depth of field, bright clean coastal background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: 5500K high-key coastal daylight with white sand fill, even exposure, soft pastel tones, minimal shadows and clean digital clarity.
prompt.technical_specs: iPhone 15 Pro front selfie, 24mm, computational photography, deep focus, high exposure, realistic skin and sand particles.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: An approved adult woman with a porcelain-inspired but natural appearance, platinum blonde hair in tight double braids, huge ice-blue eyes, pale skin with realistic texture, natural-colored lips, and vibrant blue nails takes a high-angle iPhone 15 Pro selfie on a vast sandy beach. She wears a light-blue opaque fitted cotton top with a secure neckline and raises one hand to block the glaring sun. A blurry horizon sits behind her. Use 24mm front-camera perspective, 5500K high-key coastal daylight, white sand reflection fill, deep depth of field, clear digital detail, soft pastel tones, and even lighting.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, ultra-deep V-neck, exposed collarbone emphasis, transparent top, sexualized gaze, nudity, snow, winter clothing, red nails, black top, text, logo, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

assets.usage: Beach, sand, sky, braids, blue palette, hand gesture, and high-angle selfie reference.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, braids, eyes, beach, blue palette, hand gesture, and high-angle composition; replace wardrobe with an equally opaque pastel alternative. Keep typography absent.

changes: Replaced ultra-deep V-neck and exposed-neckline emphasis with an opaque secure-neckline top; retained the porcelain-inspired coastal concept.
